2607.21933.title: Semiotic logical hexagon theory for LLM logical reasoning
2607.21933.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become powerful tools for language understanding and logical reasoning. However, they still make mistakes when a problem requires both understanding meaning and following logic. A key reason is that natural-language statements often carry implicit semantic relations before any formal reasoning begins. If these hidden meanings are not properly organized, the model may reach incorrect conclusions even when the subsequent reasoning process appears logically valid. Existing methods improve reasoning through decomposition, symbolic translation, external solvers, or self-verification, but pay comparatively less attention to the semantic structure on which reasoning depends. In this paper, we further investigate how semantic organization influences logical reasoning in LLMs. To this end, we propose HexLogicAgent, a framework that first organizes the meaning of natural-language statements and then guides logical reasoning through structured verification. In our investigation, we also make two observations. First, incomplete semantic representations, rather than deductive inference itself, are a major source of logical reasoning failures in LLMs. Second, explicitly modeling the complete structure of semantic opposition substantially delays the degradation of reasoning performance as logical complexity increases. Experiments on challenging logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that HexLogicAgent consistently improves reasoning reliability across multiple LLMs. The core idea is supported by a logical hexagon theory, which explains why a complete structure of opposing meanings is necessary for reliable reasoning.
2607.21933.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已成為語言理解和邏輯推理的強大工具。<lb/>然而，當問題同時需要理解意義和遵循邏輯時，它們仍然會犯錯。<lb/>一個關鍵原因是，自然語言陳述在任何正式推理開始之前，通常會攜帶隱含的語義關係。<lb/>如果這些隱藏的意義未能得到妥善組織，模型可能會得出不正確的結論，即使隨後的推理過程看起來在邏輯上是有效的。<lb/>現有的方法通過分解、符號翻譯、外部求解器或自我驗證來改善推理，但對推理所依賴的語義結構的關注相對較少。<lb/>在本文中，我們進一步探討語義組織如何影響LLMs中的邏輯推理。<lb/>為此，我們提出了HexLogicAgent，一個首先組織自然語言陳述意義，然後通過結構化驗證引導邏輯推理的框架。<lb/>在我們的研究中，我們還做出了兩個觀察。<lb/>首先，不完整的語義表徵，而不是演繹推理本身，是LLMs中邏輯推理失敗的主要來源。<lb/>其次，明確建模語義對立的完整結構在邏輯複雜性增加時顯著延遲推理性能的下降。<lb/>在具有挑戰性的邏輯推理基準上的實驗表明，HexLogicAgent在多個LLMs中始終提高了推理的可靠性。<lb/>這一核心思想得到了邏輯六邊形理論的支持，該理論解釋了為什麼對立意義的完整結構對於可靠推理是必要的。
